title: REAching the Calorie goal with Telemedicine in the ICU. A randomized controlled study.
summary: This study will be conducted in participating intensive care units (ICUs) of the Department of Anesthesiology and Intensive Care Medicine (CCM, CVK) of Charité - Universitätsmedizin Berlin. Patients included in the study will be randomly assigned to either the intervention or routine care group. For both groups, the patients' target calorie intake will be measured using indirect calorimetry (a method for measuring energy expenditure) according to internal clinic instructions. If this is not possible, the target is estimated using a formula recommended in the international guidelines. The intervention and study data will be collected up to and including ITS treatment day 14 or until ITS discharge (whichever comes first). Follow-up examinations will be performed at 3 or 6 months after ITS discharge.
conditions: Protein-energy malnutrition of moderate and mild degree
Muscle wasting and atrophy, not elsewhere classified

interventions.name: Telemedical implementation of the nutritional assessment and management of nutritional therapy in accordance with guidelines and the clinic's internal standard operating procedure (SOP)
Standard nutritional therapy in accordance with guidelines and the clinic's internal standard operating procedure (SOP) from the local treatment team on site

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Age ≥ 18 years
- previous intensive care length of stay <72h
- expected duration of treatment ≥ 72h
- indication for enteral or parenteral nutrition
- non-consenting patients who are included via a caregiver/spouse representative/authorized representative until study day 14 and subsequently consent themselves until hospital discharge
- patients capable of giving consent who consent before the start of the intervention
Exclusion criteria:
- refusal to participate in the study
- parallel participation in a prospective intervention study (unless parallel inclusion was permitted by the study management)
